The `UserService` binary only listens on **9090** (Thrift) — netstat shows a single listener on 9090, and the binary contains no `healthz` symbol at all. Every other service in this app has no readiness probe.
2. **Effect**: with `failureThreshold=1`, the kubelet marks the pod NotReady forever. The `user-service` Service therefore has **zero ready endpoints** (only `notReadyAddresses`).
